title: Add independent confirmed map-pin and district-search intake locations

acceptance.text: Version licensed local boundaries with explicit 64-district mapping and tested containment.
acceptance.evidence: Pinned geoBoundaries BGD-ADM2-16705992 at 9469f09, CC BY 3.0 IGO, verified Git LFS/source/output SHA-256, 64 explicit mappings with ten aliases. Local simplified geometry preserves all rings/coordinates. Containment, holes/multipolygons, border ambiguity and all 64 independent geometry-derived fixtures pass in the 30-test intake/location suite.
acceptance.how: Pin licensed geoBoundaries metadata/geometry and verify checksums; map all 64 source feature IDs/names explicitly; test containment, holes, multipolygons and border ambiguity.
acceptance.verification: Source and runtime integrity, mapping bijection, 64 independent geometry-derived interiors and synthetic topology cases pass. No bounding-box or nearest-district acceptance.

acceptance.text: Integrate MapLibre, independent location methods, migration and accessible map lifecycle in the mounted intake.
acceptance.evidence: Mounted reference intake uses a lazy Next Client Component MapLibre bridge, local containment, draggable/keyboard-movable pending pins and explicit confirmation. Separate district search, schema/envelope v2 migration, pending saved-pin recheck and draft/last-valid-submission separation are implemented. UI submit-handler and map lifecycle/failure tests pass; full successful browser walkthroughs remain unverified because browser/native control tools failed.
acceptance.how: Extend the actual mounted form with independent methods, lazy MapLibre bridge, explicit pin confirmation, local resolution, lifecycle cleanup, v2 migration and no stale location state. Preserve all six required questions.
acceptance.verification: Actual UI-controller submit handler supports both methods and rejects unconfirmed pins; pure/mocked lifecycle and failure checks pass. Full browser/physical-device checks are separately reported, not assumed.

acceptance.text: Run regression, browser, syntax, lint/build and workflow checks; document providers, limitations and handoff.
acceptance.evidence: 31 intake/location tests and 46 workflow tests pass; five changed reference scripts pass direct Node syntax checks, lint and webpack production build pass, deterministic boundary rebuild and all eight loopback asset/checksum/license checks pass, and workflow validation passes. Browser connector/native pointer failures prevented reliable complete submissions and current map mobile/physical testing; docs/LOCATION_QA.md explicitly records these unverified checks and next reviewer. One Fardin command is logged; no commit/push/deploy.
acceptance.how: Run existing/regression tests, direct script syntax, lint/build, reproducible asset/HTTP checks and workflow validation. Record browser attempts and not-performed checks, provider rights, migration and independent handoff.
acceptance.verification: Actual check outputs and limitations are recorded; no G0/science or human review acceptance, commit, push or deployment is claimed.
